أنكتب (form VII)
# أَنْكَتِبُ (ʔankatibu) /ʔan.ka.ti.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْكَتَبَ (inkataba)
# أَنْكَتِبَ (ʔankatiba) /ʔan.ka.ti.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَتَبَ (inkataba)
# أَنْكَتِبْ (ʔankatib) /ʔan.ka.tib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْكَتَبَ (inkataba)
